chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī, he said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله saw a man who had two sons, and he kissed one of them and left the other. So the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله said to him, "Why did you not treat them equally?"

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakūnī, the narrator to whom this report is attributed
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.وَاسَيْتَ: you treated with equality and fairness

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله teach about treating children equally?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches fairness and equal affection between children. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله reproached showing preference to one child over another, indicating the ethical importance of justice within the family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4704 - In the narration of Al-Sakooni, it is reported that the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) saw a man who had two sons.

The man kissed one of them and left the other.
The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said to him, "Why did you not treat them equally?"
